component.name: neo-platform
component.description: Neo AI Control platform (neocontrol.ai) — assessment, red-team, and vendor AI review engine.

components.name: Claude Opus 4.6
components.description: Deep-reasoning engine model (ENGINE_MODELS.deep): assessment reasoning, red-team generation, vendor AI risk evaluation.

useCases: vendor AI risk classification and scoring
technicalLimitations: Has a knowledge cutoff and can produce errors; engine outputs are reviewed by a human in the decision board before action.

ethicalConsiderations.name: Data handling
ethicalConsiderations.mitigationStrategy: First-party Anthropic API only; customer inputs are not used to train models. Third-party model routing (Bedrock/Vertex) and ZDR paths that would weaken these assurances are avoided for the engine.

components.name: Claude Sonnet 4.6
components.description: Fast engine model (ENGINE_MODELS.fast): use-case classification, risk tiering, question-pack generation, product lookup.

ethicalConsiderations.name: Data handling
ethicalConsiderations.mitigationStrategy: First-party Anthropic API only; customer inputs are not used to train models.
